changes.title: Call or ask for a quote from any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage is a fixed desktop layout that shrinks on a phone, and the numbers can't be tapped. The concept puts tap to call and a short quote request at the top of every screen.

changes.title: More than a century of family history up front.
changes.text: Your 1912 founding, the Baylor Top Texas Family Business honor and your family team are tucked into small news blurbs today. The concept leads with them.

changes.title: Every service, easy to find.
changes.text: The homepage lists more than thirty services in a long side menu. The concept groups them into drilling, pump service, irrigation and public water supply.
